handoff.salientSummary: User testing validation for infrastructure milestone completed successfully. All 17 assertions (3 API health/readiness, 14 PostgreSQL database) passed. Services started, flow validators spawned and completed, results synthesized and validation-state.json updated.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: User testing validation for milestone 'infrastructure'. Determined 17 testable assertions from features' fulfills mapping (VAL-API-027/028/029 for health endpoints, VAL-DB-001 through VAL-DB-014 for PostgreSQL database). Set up environment: started PostgreSQL container (eval-postgres port 3105), Redis container (eval-redis port 3106), and API server (port 3100). Spawned 2 flow validator subagents (api-health and postgres-db) that tested all assertions via curl and psql. Synthesized results: all 17 assertions passed. Updated validation-state.json with passed status. Created synthesis report at validation/infrastructure/user-testing/synthesis.json. Added Flow Validator Guidance sections to library/user-testing.md for future runs.

commandsRun.command: docker exec eval-postgres psql -U eval_user -d evaluations -c '\d evaluations'
commandsRun.observation: Table has all required columns with correct types, constraints, indexes
